contexts.text: Spiral windings around the feet represented a desire to insinuate themselves... SE 4082.
The cuticles (with such) consist of spires...
The closing of the spiritual degree is like the retorsion of a spire into the opposite... 263-, Explained. DLW 203:2.
But if the spiritual mind is opened... it reverses the spire in which are the action and reaction of the natural mind. Explained.
The state of the natural mind before reformation may be compared to a spire winding downwards; but after it to a spire winding upwards...
With the good, these (organic forms) are spirated forwards; with the evil, backwards...
His turban was wound in spires like a snake...
A bright light wound down in spiral windings...
The fibril of the nerve coils itself into a spire.
The cloud wound itself into the form of a spiral.
Those who are elevated... as it were into a spire [do] the best.
The Spirits (through whom the influx came in succession) formed a kind of circular spire; so that the influxes of the Lord's life inflow as it were through a form perpetually spiral.
The most deceitful (acted by) spiral windings.
She had a chamber drawn out into a spire, and she entered through the spire, and sat in the middle, and ruled thence on all sides.
(This magic) is done with a spiral figure in deceitful ways...
